facts.fact: The National Bureau of Statistics held a two-day in-boarding training in Abuja and distributed hardware and software to 15 pilot ministries, departments and agencies for the World Bank-supported Integrated Systems of Administrative Statistics, whose MDAs were to sign a Data Supply Pledge to share administrative data regularly.
